taxonomic_note: Accepted hybrid × formula and scientific concept verified against Kew; the iNaturalist observation omits the multiplication symbol in its taxon label. Distinguishing hybrid anatomy requires separate visual review.
look_here_first: This is the accepted NATURAL HYBRID Chloris cucullata × C. verticillata. A head with seemingly intermediate raceme length or crowding is NOT by itself proof of hybrid identity. The provisional source image depicts a windmill head; verify mature sterile lemma shape, both awns, parental characters, a voucher and source concept before certifying an individual.

comparisons.key_distinctions: Kew accepts ×subdolichostachya as the cucullata × verticillata hybrid and describes intermediate features: racemes digitate 5–16, longer than some hooded heads; fertile lemma awn 2–5 mm, upper sterile lemma awn 1–2 mm, upper sterile lemma oblong rather than dramatically orbicular. These overlap parent characters; do not use a photograph of a windmill silhouette to confirm parentage.

crew_field_walkthrough: Locate the main hub and long slim reddish racemes on the source-reported hybrid head, photographed against a hand.
Compare a verified hooded and a verified tumble windmillgrass whole head, then photograph any intermediate characters on the SAME whole plant.
Measure the fertile and upper sterile lemmas and their awns independently, photograph the upper sterile lemma profile, and seek expert/voucher determination.
